papers.title: TimeClaw: Harnessing Generalist Agents for Contextualized Time Series
papers.what: Agentic harness gives a frozen LLM time-series-native tools, reusable analytical routines, and episodic multimodal memory for contextualized temporal reasoning.

papers.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
papers.what: Text-space optimizer trains agent skill documents with validation-gated edits; +23.5 points on GPT-5.5 direct chat, zero inference overhead.

papers.title: M3Exam: Benchmarking Multimodal Memory for Realistic User-Agent Interactions
papers.what: Query-centric benchmark scores agent memory on cross-modal grounding and implicit inference over realistic user-agent interactions.
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026), Agent AI Survey (Durante 2024)

papers.title: UniCanvas: A Diffusion-based Unified Model for Text-in-Image Joint Generation
papers.what: Diffusion model draws language as visual patterns on the pixel canvas, unifying text and image generation without a discrete token head.
